title: Fifth Page Resonance
next_chapter_hook: When the price of the contract was revealed, Chen Ji finally understood—that every power bestowed by the Tianji Record had long been secretly marked with a price he could not afford.

text.content:
The moment those eyes opened, the entire core of the Heavenly Dao's Eye felt as if gripped by an invisible hand.

Not pressure, yet more suffocating than pressure.

Those were eyes without pupils, a blank whiteness, as if gazing from the void itself. Chen Ji felt the Tianji Record on his chest suddenly scorch hot, and the fourth page runes on that fragment pulsed frantically, resonating across the distance with those hollow eyes.

dialogue.content:
'...You have finally arrived.'

The voice resonated directly in Chen Ji's mind, bypassing his ears entirely, leaving no gap for evasion. It carried no emotion, no warmth, yet it made every hair on Chen Ji's body stand on end.

text.content:
Chen Ji instinctively stepped back half a pace, yet found his feet rooted to the ground as if they had taken root.

Those hollow eyes shifted slowly, as if examining him, or perhaps examining the fragment at his chest. Chen Nian stood at his side, her white robes rippling without wind. Her voice was soft: 'Brother, it's looking at you.'

I know. Chen Ji answered in his heart, his fingers secretly pressing against the Tianji Record.

dialogue.content:
'Inheritor of the Tianji Record.' Those hollow eyes suddenly curved, as if mocking, 'No, it should be said—the chess piece selected by the Tianji Record.'

Chen Ji narrowed his eyes, a cold smile curling at his lips: 'A chess piece? How interesting you say that. The Tianji Record recognizes its master—I believe it chose me, not the other way around.'

text.content:
The Heavenly Dao's Eye fell silent for a moment, then let out a low sound that seemed like a chuckle.

'Interesting. In ten thousand years, you are the first inheritor who dares speak to me this way.'

Chen Ji felt a searing heat in his chest as the fifth page runes of the Tianji Record began to awaken. He watched as words gradually materialized on that blank page, as if an invisible hand were writing.

dialogue.content:
'Do not be hasty to look.' The voice suddenly carried a certain implication, 'The price of the fifth page—you cannot yet afford it.'

A sharp glint flashed in Chen Ji's eyes. Price?

The price was the least of his concerns. From a废物杂役 to his current position orchestrating the world, which step hadn't he wagered his life on?

text.content:
'Since you know I am the inheritor of the Tianji Record, surely you understand—I, Chen Ji, never make a losing trade.' He stepped forward, staring directly into those hollow eyes, 'You went to great lengths to bring me to this core—surely not just to intimidate me?'

Chen Nian beside him gently tugged at his sleeve, but he turned and grasped her hand, signaling her to stay calm.

dialogue.content:
'Bold spirit.'

Those hollow eyes suddenly flipped, revealing dense rows of text within—the complete content of the Tianji Record, content Chen Ji had never seen before.

'Look carefully, inheritor. The Tianji Record has nine pages total. You currently possess five pages, barely sufficient to predict events within three hours.'

'As for the fifth page's ability—' the voice suddenly dropped lower, 'it is to rewrite.'

Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply.

Rewrite? Not prediction, but rewrite?

'The so-called rewriting means bypassing Heavenly Dao rules, directly erasing a segment of fate from the chain of causality, and rewriting it.'

text.content:
Chen Ji's breath quickened.

If this was true—he wouldn't just be able to foresee the future, but change it!

Chen Nian seemed to sense his excitement, gently squeezing his hand. Chen Ji drew a deep breath, suppressing his inner elation, his gaze instead growing colder: 'And the price?'

dialogue.content:
'You are quite composed.' Those hollow eyes curved again, 'Each time you rewrite fate, the Heavenly Fate Value consumed is not five points, but fifty.'

Fifty points!

Chen Ji's heart tightened. How much Heavenly Fate Value did he have in total? Every divination consumed five points—how many more could he withstand?

text.content:
'That is not all.' The voice continued, 'Rewriting fate will trigger the backlash from the Heavenly Dao's origin. Each time you use it, your 'mark' in the eyes of the Heavenly Dao deepens. When the mark accumulates to a certain critical point—'

It did not finish, but Chen Ji already understood.

The Heavenly Dao's Eye. The ultimate antagonist, would notice him.

choice.prompt: Facing the fifth page's ability and price of the Tianji Record, Chen Ji needed to make a choice—

choices.text: Accept the price, activate the fifth page immediately
choices.description: Since this is the ability to rewrite fate, no matter how great the price, it must be mastered at once. Hesitation means defeat.
choices.visible_cost: Heavenly Fate Value -50/time, Heavenly Dao mark deepens
choices.risk_hint: Heavenly Dao mark may expose location

text.content:
Chen Ji did not hesitate, pressing his palm against the Tianji Record: 'Activate.'

The moment the words fell, a tearing pain spread from his chest throughout his entire body. He watched his Heavenly Fate Value pour out like a waterfall, that originally abundant number plummeting to its lowest point.

Yet at the same time, the fifth page runes fully bloomed, revealing a line of ancient text—'Fate is crafted by oneself.'

choices.text: First stabilize the Heavenly Dao's Eye, extract more intelligence
choices.description: Cannot act rashly. Why did the Heavenly Dao's Eye voluntarily reveal this? There must be something suspicious behind it. First extract information, then decide.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji not only didn't activate it, but stepped back instead, looking at those hollow eyes with an enigmatic smile: "Senior, you're suddenly so kind as to tell me all this—let me ask you: what do you want?"

choices.text: Demanding the Tianji Record Itself to Give an Explanation
choices.description: The Tianji Record recognizes its master, it should have independent will. Let it answer—how should this contract be set.
choices.visible_cost: May Offend the Heavenly Dao's Eye
choices.visible_reward: Establishing a Deeper Connection with the Tianji Record
choices.risk_hint: The Heavenly Dao's Eye May Rage

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji suddenly closed his eyes, immersing his divine sense into the Tianji Record on his chest. He silently thought: "Old Mo, are you there? Tianji Record, this is your own affair—won't you say something?"

A moment later, a familiar residual soul fluctuation came—the voice of Mo Xiansheng: "Young Master, it's right. But it didn't tell you everything."

text.content:
The Heavenly Dao's Eye seemed to sense something, a fluctuation appearing in those hollow eyes.

"You're talking to it?" The tone actually carried a hint of... wariness?

Chen Ji opened his eyes, a playful arc curving his lips. He suddenly understood something—the Heavenly Dao's Eye had never feared him, but the Tianji Record itself.

dialogue.content:
"Senior, you are the Heavenly Dao's Eye, representing the will of Heaven." Chen Ji said word by word, "But the Tianji Record wasn't created by you, was it?"

Those hollow eyes slightly contracted.

Chen Ji's heart solidified. The origin of the Tianji Record was more complex than he imagined. And this Heavenly Dao's Eye was clearly using him—or, fearing him.

text.content:
At that moment, the Tianji Record suddenly flipped on its own.

The fifth page blazed with light, forming some strange resonance with the Heavenly Dao's Eye's hollow gaze. Chen Ji felt a foreign consciousness awakening from the fifth page—ancient and desolate, yet carrying a hint of... intimacy?

"Successor." The consciousness directly rang in his mind, not the voice of the Heavenly Dao's Eye, but the Tianji Record itself, "Do you want to know the truth?"

choice.prompt: The Tianji Record's Will Actively Awakens, Chen Ji Faces a Choice—

choices.text: Of Course, I Choose to Trust the Tianji Record
choices.description: The Tianji Record Recognizes its master, it Won't Harm Me. More Importantly—It's the Only Force Standing on My Side.
choices.visible_reward: The Tianji Record Reveals Key Truth
choices.risk_hint: Key Information May Be Hidden by the Tianji Record

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji closed his eyes and said softly: "Speak."

At that moment, he felt something flowing within the Tianji Record—like a river of memories spanning ten thousand years, opening itself to him.

choices.text: I Trust No One, Including You
choices.description: There is no kindness without reason in this world. Why did the Tianji Record choose me? What is its purpose?
choices.visible_reward: Maintaining Independence, Uninfluenced by Any Side
choices.risk_hint: May Be Manipulated by the Heavenly Dao's Eye

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji didn't respond to that consciousness, but instead opened his eyes, looking at the Heavenly Dao's Eye: "Senior, you speak first."

He wanted to watch these two sides fight it out first, sitting on the mountain to observe the tigers.

text.content:
The Tianji Record's consciousness echoed in Chen Ji's mind, carrying a strange warmth:

"I am the last creation of Tianji Old Man. Ten thousand years ago, he foresaw the Heavenly Dao's Eye's conspiracy and left me to find someone who could break the chess game."

Chen Ji's heart shook. Tianji Old Man?

dialogue.content: "Enough!" The Heavenly Eye suddenly erupted in rage, the hollow eyes bursting with dazzling light. A world-destroying pressure bore down on Chen Ji. Chen Ling cried out, blocking in front of him. "Heavenly Secrets Elder died ten thousand years ago!" The voice was sharp and piercing, "Do you think leaving behind a single fragment can overturn the heavens?!"

text.content: Chen Ji looked at that pressure and suddenly smiled. "Elder, you're impatient." He said softly, "That proves I hit the mark. What Heavenly Secrets Elder left behind is quite threatening to you." He patted Chen Ling blocking his path, signaling her to step back, then stepped forward, facing that pressure directly: "Since that's the case, do you think I'll just leave this power unused?"

dialogue.content: "Do you think you can threaten this seat?" The Heavenly Eye's voice was ice-cold and piercing. Chen Ji shook his head: "Not a threat, a deal. You're wary of the Tianji Record, and I know your power. But right now, we're both at the core—do you think it would be easier for you to kill me, or for me to activate the fifth page?"

text.content: At that moment, Chen Ji felt the power of the Tianji Record's fifth page surge within him. That was the power to rewrite fate. Even as merely a prototype, it was enough for him to stand firm under the Heavenly Eye's pressure. "Interesting." The Heavenly Eye's pressure suddenly receded, "What do you want?" Chen Ji smiled—this was the most satisfying smile he'd had in years: "I want to know—what are you actually afraid of."

choice.prompt: Chen Ji seized the initiative, the Heavenly Eye was forced to compromise, and he needed to decide the next step—

choices.text: Press for the truth about Heavenly Secrets Elder
choices.description: Who is Heavenly Secrets Elder? Why did he create the Tianji Record? Why is the Heavenly Eye so wary?
choices.risk_hint: May provoke the Heavenly Eye's anger

dialogue.content: Chen Ji stood with hands behind his back, his gaze sharp as a blade: "Who is Heavenly Secrets Elder? Why did he create me to deal with you?" The Heavenly Eye fell silent for a moment, then finally spoke: "He... was the previous Heavenly Eye."

choices.text: Demand it release the binding on Chen Ling
choices.description: My sister was taken by the Holy Sect as a 'Heavenly Fate Lock Key'—does the Heavenly Eye have a hand in this?
choices.visible_reward: Obtain crucial information to save Chen Ling
choices.risk_hint: May provoke the Heavenly Eye's anger

dialogue.content: Chen Ji's gaze fell on Chen Ling, his tone suddenly turning cold: "My sister was taken by the Holy Sect as something called a 'Heavenly Fate Lock Key'—how much of this is your doing?" Chen Ling's body stiffened, looking at him. "If you want me to help you deal with the Tianji Record, give her back to me first."

choices.description: I don't want your charity. Since we both have what the other wants, let's cooperate as equals.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji suddenly released all his momentum, instead showing a warm smile: "Elder, let's not fight. You have your difficulties, I have my goals. Instead of mutual suspicion, why not cooperate?"

text.content: The Heavenly Eye fell silent for a long while. In those hollow eyes, complex emotions swirled—wariness, anger, helplessness—finally turning into a long sigh. "You truly are the one chosen by the Tianji Record." The voice was no longer ice-cold, but carried a hint of... exhaustion? "Heavenly Secrets Elder was exactly this cunning back then."

dialogue.content: "You want to know the truth?" The Heavenly Eye's voice suddenly became ethereal, "Then I'll tell you—Heavenly Secrets Elder was the first Heavenly Eye. After discovering the truth of the Heavenly Way, he wanted to shatter it, so he was erased by the Heavenly Way's origin." Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. "And I am the will reshaped by the Heavenly Way's origin." The voice carried a hint of bitterness, "I came to replace him, and to continue his will—only in the opposite direction."

text.content: Chen Ji felt his mind in chaos. Was Tianji Old Man the first generation of Heavenly Eyes? He wanted to break through the Heavenly Mandate and was erased? And the current Heavenly Eyes, remade by Heaven's Origin, were to continue that 'opposite direction' will? 'So...' Chen Ji said in a deep voice, 'You've come to stop the Tianji Record from completing its mission.'

dialogue.content: 'No.' The Heavenly Eyes suddenly denied. 'I've come—to use you.' Chen Ji was stunned. 'When the Tianji Record gathers nine pages, it can reshape the Heavenly Mandate. By then, you will either become the new Heavenly Eyes, or—' The voice suddenly paused. 'Or let Tianji Old Man resurrect through your body.' Chen Ling cried out. Yet Chen Ji smiled instead: 'So you've always wanted me to collect the Tianji Record for this?'

text.content: 'You're a chess piece, the Tianji Record is a chess piece, and I am also a chess piece.' The Heavenly Eyes' voice carried a hint of sorrow. 'We are all within Heaven's chess game. No one can stand aside.' Chen Ji suddenly understood. This was not simple good versus evil, nor straightforward righteous against wicked. This was—a layout spanning ten thousand years. And he was merely one link. 'Then what do you want to do?' he asked.

dialogue.content: 'Cooperate.' The Heavenly Eyes said, 'I'll help you collect the Tianji Record, and you help me prevent Tianji Old Man from resurrecting. And when you gather the nine pages—' 'We'll discuss it then?' Chen Ji interjected. The Heavenly Eyes fell silent for a moment, then let out a low laugh: 'Interesting. You're even more arrogant than he was back then.' 'Then—' Chen Ji extended his hand. 'Deal?'

text.content: A hand condensed from light stretched out from the Heavenly Eyes, touching Chen Ji's palm. In that moment, Chen Ji felt the fifth page of the Tianji Record fully bloom. Countless information flooded into his mind—the complete abilities of the Tianji Record, and the price to activate them. 'The contract is sealed.' The Heavenly Eyes' voice gradually faded away. 'Go, Successor. Go collect the remaining four pages.' The light dissipated, and Chen Ji found himself standing in a void, Chen Ling still standing beside him.

Chen Ji lowered his head to look at his chest. The fifth page of the Tianji Record had fully manifested. On that page were only four characters, yet they made his heart surge. 'Fate is Self-Created.' The ability to rewrite destiny was finally in his hands. 'Brother.' Chen Ling gently tugged his sleeve. 'You were...incredible just now.' A faint smile curved Chen Ji's lips. He touched his sister's head, but his gaze was profound as an abyss: 'It's not over yet. The Heavenly Eyes' words can only be trusted thirty percent.'

The Tianji Record's consciousness rippled in his mind, as if responding to his vigilance. Chen Ji suddenly smiled. He pressed his hand against the Tianji Record and whispered in his heart: 'From now on, we're partners. If you have something to say, say it directly. No hiding.' After a moment of silence, a voice with a hint of warmth rang out: '...Young Master, you've finally treated me as one of your own.' It was Mo Xiansheng's voice, also the will of the Tianji Record itself. Chen Ji felt a warmth spread in his chest—he was finally, no longer alone.
